title: 第十七章短暂的安全PK求追读第十八章掌握新的技艺PK求追读
content_zh:

“进！”
门外。
一道有些苍老的声音传出。
江宁也缓缓推开后院的大门。
他赫然宛如昨天那般，看到年约五十的王进祥和的躺在藤椅上晒太阳，好似一位普通的庄稼老汉。
除了王进身边没有李晴师姐，与昨日看上去一般无二。
“师父！”江宁微微行礼。
“这个时候来找我可有什么事？”王进开口。
江宁神情恭敬：“我想长居武馆，求个事做！我不要工钱！”
“求个事？为何？”王进有些好奇。
江宁沉吟了一息，便开口：“武馆外有人想对付我。”
“原来如此！”王进点点头，然后继续开口：“既然如此，那你就留下来吧！每日练功结束后，去后院劈柴可能接受？”
“能！！”江宁点头，心中一喜。
“工钱没有，管吃管住，可能接受？”王进再问。
“能！！”江宁再次点头，然后拱手：“多谢师父大恩！！！”
王进双眼微眯，显露出皱纹，脸上的皮肤也形成褶皱，他随后挥挥手：“那下去吧！”
随后又叮嘱了一声：“好好练武，只要把五禽拳练好，谁想对付你直接打死就行！五禽拳真正的核心是五禽齐修，只要达到一定的火候，实力可不会弱！”
“是，弟子明白了！”江宁躬身。
......

退出后院。
江宁脸上露出一抹微笑，悬着的心也落了下来。
能长居武馆，那自身安危就暂时无忧。
沧浪武馆，即使放在整個洛水县都是最安全的几个地方之一。
【五禽拳经验值+2】
练了一遍拳后，消耗了中午恢复的体力，江宁又直接取出那颗野参。
如今时间紧迫，他自然不会吝啬野参的消耗。
拳法每精进一步，气血每多凝练一缕，他的实力也会强上一分。
又是十分之一总量的野参入腹。
江宁就感觉到体内传来阵阵暖流，在药力的支持下，心脏跃动变得有力而强劲，浑身精力逐渐变得充沛。
他也在前院直接开始练拳。
【五禽拳经验值+1】
......

"Come in!"
outside the door.
A somewhat old voice came out.
Jiang Ning also slowly opened the backyard door.
It was as if it was yesterday that he saw Wang Jin, who was about fifty years old, lying peacefully on a wicker chair and basking in the sun, like an ordinary old farmer.
Except that there is no senior sister Li Qing next to Wang Jin, he looks the same as yesterday.
"Master!" Jiang Ning saluted slightly.
"What's the point of coming to me at this time?" Wang Jin asked.
Jiang Ning looked respectful: "I want to live in the martial arts gym forever. I want to ask for something to do! I don't want wages!"
"Asking for a favor? Why?" Wang Jin was a little curious.
Jiang Ning pondered for a moment and then said, "There is someone outside the martial arts gym who wants to deal with me."
"That's it!" Wang Jin nodded, and then continued: "In that case, then you can stay! Is it acceptable to go to the backyard to chop wood after daily practice?"
"Yes!!" Jiang Ning nodded, feeling happy.
"There is no salary, but food and housing are taken care of. Is it possible to accept it?" Wang Jin asked again.
"Yes!!" Jiang Ning nodded again, and then handed over his hand: "Thank you Master for your kindness!!!"
Wang Jin's eyes narrowed slightly, revealing wrinkles, and the skin on his face also formed wrinkles. He then waved his hand: "Then get on!"
Then he warned again: "Practice your martial arts well. As long as you practice Wuqinquan well, anyone who wants to deal with you can just kill you! The real core of Wuqinquan is the simultaneous cultivation of the five animals. As long as it reaches a certain level, the strength will not be weak!"
"Yes, disciple understands!" Jiang Ning bowed.
...
Exit to the backyard.
A smile appeared on Jiang Ning's face, and her heart dropped.
If you can stay in the martial arts hall for a long time, you will not worry about your own safety for the time being.
Canglang Martial Arts School is one of the safest places in the entire Luoshui County.
[Five-animal fist experience value +2]
After practicing his boxing once and consuming the energy he had recovered at noon, Jiang Ning directly took out the wild ginseng.
Now that time is running out, he will naturally not skimp on the consumption of wild ginseng.
With each further refinement of his boxing skills, and with each additional ray of Qi and blood condensed, his strength will become stronger.
Another tenth of the total amount of wild ginseng entered the stomach.
Jiang Ning felt waves of warmth coming from his body. With the support of the medicine, his heart beat became powerful and powerful, and his whole body gradually became more energetic.
He also started boxing right in the front yard.
[Five-animal fist experience value +1]
